metric: flashcard_back_verbatim_overlap_with_notes (OBJECTIVE/MECHANICAL -- exact substring match; measures literal text reuse, NOT correctness/relevance/quality)
interpretation_caveat: A HIGH verbatim rate is expected-by-construction for the deterministic condition (Phase 1: _build_flashcards extracts the actual sentence containing a bold term). A LOW verbatim rate for the LLM condition does not imply lower quality -- paraphrasing is not a defect. This metric measures extraction-vs-paraphrase behavior, not quality; it is NOT a substitute for the human correctness/relevance rubric (HUMAN_DATA_REQUIRED).
